producer_report.summary: Dependencies now come only from a full job id on a 'Depends on' line (case-insensitive, with optional '>', list marker or numbering) or the retry link of a 'try again on <id>' request. The change is a new `reading::dependency_ids_in`, which `plan_entry` now uses. Ids cited elsewhere stay references for the reader and no longer hold an item. The hold logic and its reason text are unchanged. I added reading tests for the planned case, the held and released cases, and the line shapes, and a drain test for an item that only cites a rejected job. I updated the existing reading and drain tests that used 'after <id>'. I also updated the `plan_entry` doc comment, the plan.rs docs and the CHANGELOG Fixed entry. `athena plan` printed 'nothing is open' here because the working copy has no records, so I could not show the real queue's held list.

checks_run.note: The working copy has no records, so it printed 'nothing is open: no queued request is waiting to be planned'. It cannot show the real queue's held list.
5 passed, including an_item_that_only_cites_a_rejected_job_is_planned_not_held and the updated held-dependency test
11 passed, including the 2 new reading tests

criteria_check.criterion: A new test through Plan::build_with (with a plan_entry built from request text) shows a request that quotes a rejected job id in its text with no 'Depends on' line is planned, not in Plan::refused. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: A test in reading.rs builds a request with plan_entry and passes it to Plan::build_with. It asserts the item is in order, refused is empty and depends_on is empty. cargo test -p athena-core depend passed (11 tests).

criteria_check.criterion: A new test shows a request with a 'Depends on <id>' line naming a rejected job with no landed retry is still held, and its Refusal reason contains 'depends on <id>' and 'rejected'. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: reading::tests::a_depends_on_line_naming_a_rejected_job_with_no_landed_retry_still_holds_the_item passed in cargo test -p athena-core depend. It checks the reason text and that a landed retry releases the item.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test shows a 'try again on <id>' request still depends on that id, and that an id in a 'Depends on' line is a dependency while the same id elsewhere in the text is not. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: reading::tests::dependencies_are_only_depends_on_ids_and_the_retry_link passed in cargo test -p athena-core depend.

criteria_check.criterion: Run on this repository's queue, athena plan (cargo run -- plan) holds no item whose only rejected or failed id is outside a 'Depends on' line; the job report shows this.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo run --bin athena -- plan ran in the working copy and printed 'plan nothing is open: no queued request is waiting to be planned', so it held no item. This copy has no records branch (records/ is absent by design), so the real queue's 29 held items cannot be reproduced here. The cause is gone because depends_on now comes only from 'Depends on' lines and the retry link. The backing drain tests passed through the production drain::plan path: an_item_that_only_cites_a_rejected_job_is_planned_not_held leaves the citing item in report.plan.order with refused empty, and the Depends-on item is still held with its reason. The verifier can run `cargo run --bin athena -- plan` where records exist.
